key.name: modifier-prefix
key.description: Modifier key combination prepended to each vowel key. Changing this updates all five vowel shortcuts at once. Examples: <Super><Alt>, <Ctrl><Alt>, <Super><Shift>

key.name: show-notification
key.description: Show a notification when an accented character is copied to the clipboard

key.name: copy-to-clipboard
key.description: Copy the selected accented character to the clipboard

key.name: type-character
key.description: Insert the selected accented character at the current caret position

key.name: dialog-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the accent popup dialog (0–100%)

key.name: accent-vowel-a
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the accent menu for the vowel A

key.name: accent-vowel-e
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the accent menu for the vowel E

key.name: accent-vowel-i
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the accent menu for the vowel I

key.name: accent-vowel-o
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the accent menu for the vowel O

key.name: accent-vowel-u
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the accent menu for the vowel U
